name: Post-Matric Scholarship 2025-26 (simulated)
description: Synthetic scholarship ledger. Names, addresses, phones, Aadhaar numbers (valid Verhoeff checksums) and bank details follow realistic Indian formats. Families and CSC centres create legitimate sharing. Ring and lone ghosts were planted afterwards with labels kept in a separate file the detector never reads.

columns.description: Expired or deactivated Aadhaar still receiving money

ringTypes.description: Unrelated identities paying out to 1-2 bank accounts, registered in a burst from one IP
Payouts routed to one collector UPI ID; templated disposable emails
Same biometric under different names and Aadhaar numbers; same DOB and father
Burst of registrations from one IP with sequential phones and templated emails
Sequential phone numbers paying into a shared account
Unrelated surnames at one address (with spelling variants) sharing an account
Held out: same IP spread over days plus a shared address (weak signals only)
Held out: name variants with the same DOB/father and batch phones, no shared money trail

hardNegatives.description: Genuine applicants registering at a CSC centre (shared IP)
Siblings paid into a parent's account
Honest users with 5-7 failed logins over a long window

howCreated: Generated households of students with realistic names, DOBs, addresses, phones, Aadhaar numbers and bank accounts.
Added legitimate sharing: families (address, phone, account), CSC centres (shared IP), forgetful users (failed logins).
Planted 33 rings across 8 types and 240 lone ghosts with 5 trait types.
Held two ring types (slow_drip, identity_reuse) out of tuning to test generalisation.
Shuffled records and assigned IDs afterwards so order and IDs reveal nothing.

pipeline.description: Group records by pincode, phone prefix and name initials.
Fuzzy + phonetic names; exact match on account, UPI, biometric, phone, IP, email pattern.
Records and shared items become nodes; shared attributes become weighted edges.
Connected components, Louvain, IP burst windows, weighted ring score.
Aadhaar checksum and status, phone validity and duplication, login behaviour.
Top contributing signals become reasons and red table cells.

limitations: Real welfare fraud labels are not public, so the ledger is simulated.
Results are on simulated fraud plus component benchmarks, not on real welfare data.
